lastCompletedStory.title: Isolate the remaining supervisor and integration plan-runner test files and fix the stale codex-auth comment

nextStoryContext:
US-009 (CAM-420) completed the frozen plan-side census (US-003 through US-009 collectively) by isolating the last five plan-phase test files onto the configPath-fixture idiom and fixing a stale comment: test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts (NOT the same file as test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts covered by US-007 -- distinct paths, easy to confuse via grep) has two overrides builders (makeOpts: Partial<RunPlanPhaseOptions>, makeReplanOpts: Partial<RunPlanPhaseWithReplanOptions>), each given its own module-level GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH fixture (own mkdtempSync dir, [backend]
planner = "claude"
auditor = "claude"
 project.toml) plus the `'configPath' in overrides ? overrides.configPath : GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH` idiom placed after each builder's `...overrides` spread. test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-auditor-payload.test.ts's single makeOpts(issue, overrides) builder got identical treatment. Two real-tmux integration files (test/integration/plan-runner-target-obey.test.ts, 2 inline runPlanPhase call sites; test/integration/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts, 1 call site) each got a module-level fixture plus a literal `configPath: GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key on every inline opts literal. test/supervisor/plan/plan-sidecar-replan-wiring.test.ts is a pure source-text oracle over sidecar.ts (never builds a real opts literal); its derived-comparand oracle only counts 1 'call site' because the grep also matches a `'runPlanPhaseWithReplan({'` STRING LITERAL inside one of its own toContain() assertions, so instead of fabricating an unused opts object it got a one-line explanatory comment carrying the literal token `configPath: GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH`, honestly documenting the false-positive match (sidecar.ts's runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan does not itself wire configPath into runPlanPhaseWithReplan -- out of scope for this test-only story). Finally, plan-runner-codex-auth.test.ts's stale header comment ('readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel are not injectable through RunPlanPhaseOptions') was corrected: RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath IS a fixture-injectable DI seam (added US-002 of this same PRD); rewritten to say so explicitly (literal token 'fixture-injectable') while clarifying the file's tests deliberately omit configPath anyway to keep exercising the live cwd-default fallback path. plan-runner-model-resolution.test.ts (same live-default rationale) was left completely untouched per the story's explicit no-edit constraint. Zero src/ changes: all six edits were test-fixture wiring plus one comment correction. Verification: bun test unchanged at 5633 pass / 0 fail (identical count to US-008's handoff, confirming no tests added/removed); bun run typecheck clean; bun run check:all fully green (no file-size-budget.json ceiling raise needed -- each file's growth stayed under its existing budget). This closes CAM-420's plan-side census entirely; any future story adding a NEW plan-phase call site must carry its own configPath fixture wiring (or, for a pure sidecar.ts source-text oracle file with no real opts literal, document why it's exempt) to keep the isolation intact.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture DI-isolation story plus one comment correction, mirroring US-003 through US-008 of this same PRD: no new external library surface introduced. RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath already existed (US-002 of this PRD) and was already wired into readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel for the planner and auditor phases; this story only threaded the pre-existing seam into the last five plan-phase test files and corrected a stale comment referencing that same seam.
